decision: Close the exact eight-cell LazyLean E0 campaign as NO_SIGNAL with no confirmation proposal. Select the shared snapshot/reuse closure repair READY and unstarted because its two known defects threaten exact-input publication and efficient dependency-correct validation across future confirmations. Keep the historical memory audit deferred, BUILD-MODE gated and independent transfer waiting; do not start the successor or take external action.

categories.assessment: The completed E0 sample does not justify confirmation. Repairing exact-input isolation and stage dependency reuse improves the reliability and feasibility of any future E1 method without crossing an assurance milestone.

ABA validation-input contamination and global-HEAD reuse invalidation are known shared workflow risks. The eighteen-receipt memory interpretation remains unresolved but scoped to one completed resource package.
The closure repair has concrete regressions and cross-item value. No substantive upstream feedback or deadline displaces it; external transfer still lacks its required custody input.

The selected item reuses the existing exclusive resumable closure controller and refresh path, focusing on two observed local reliability gaps rather than introducing a speculative new method. The memory audit retains primary documentation scope for later.

Snapshot/reuse repair is executable after this E0 handoff and is an explicit prerequisite for future confirmation. BUILD-MODE and transfer remain blocked by scientific and external-input gates; the memory audit is feasible but not a confirmation blocker.

candidates.rationale: The plan names two reproducible existing closure failures, exact regressions, shared tooling targets and a full current/historical plus separate-checkout completion gate. The completed predecessor supplies the current controller and no external input is required.
The exact read-only eighteen-receipt audit remains feasible and useful, but the shared closure repair has broader future-experiment reliability value and removes an explicit E1 prerequisite.
Build-mode conformance still lacks bound supported configurations, input-influenced source sites and a fixed reproducible protocol.

blockers.reason: Source/configuration and fixture/build protocol must be bound before promotion.

candidates.rationale: Independent transfer still lacks an owner-designated independently curated holdout package or new target evidence.

blockers.reason: The required independent input/custody package has not been supplied.
